# Local Agent Forge

Status: pre-release source candidate; not published to npm or PyPI as checked 2026-08-30.
Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/local-agent-forge
License: MIT
Maintainer: Nymrel <contact@nymrel.com>

## Evidence-backed surface

- TypeScript and Python adapters for Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, ComfyUI, and Whisper-compatible HTTP endpoints.
- Deterministic heuristic routing decisions, runtime health probes, cost-comparison ledgers, a CLI, and experimental MCP tools.
- Loopback defaults, loopback-only proxy listener, and credential-free HTTP(S) custom endpoint validation.
- Local unit, package, and security gates described in README.md and RELEASE_READINESS.md.

## Do not infer

- No registry package, tag, release, deployment, configured provider, installed model, customer activation, privacy certification, measured savings, coverage percentage, or revenue is proven by this source tree.
- A CLOUD decision is advisory and does not execute or authorize a provider request.
- The 0.85 threshold, model names, and cost baselines are configurable or illustrative inputs and may be stale.
- MCP protocol-version output is not independent compatibility certification.

## Trusted documents

- README.md: source evaluation and runtime boundaries
- SECURITY.md: trust model and private reporting
- RELEASE_READINESS.md: publication gates
- CHANGELOG.md: unreleased source changes
